text: THE OFFICIAL NATIONAL SPORTS CENTER CONSORTIUM Site Navigation About NSCC Disappointed in your Sports Center’s financial performance? Do you find it difficult to generate sponsorship revenues, make purchases at the best prices and terms or obtain timely financing at reasonable rates? A new company wants to help. The National Sports Center Consortium (NSCC) promises you exposure to the lucrative national sponsorship dollar market, group discount purchasing and access to various capital markets– not normally available to individual centers. The NSCC consists of an affiliation of experienced sports center owners and operators, a national Business Development Firm and a national Asset Management Firm, dedicated to providing services that have not been made available to sports centers until now. The NSCC and its members are following the lead of other industries who have joined forces in order to strengthen themselves in the eyes of those they would like to do business with. The NSCC offers a range of services that can only be made available through a consortium like this. From sponsorship/revenue sharing opportunities and fund raising projects, to programs and events designed to meet the needs of your center’s teams, coaches, players, parents and other special interest groups. From the personal and professional development of your key personnel to private meetings with Venture Capital Firms. From benchmarking best practices to negotiating group rates with key suppliers, the NSCC plans to provide services the industry has asked for and needed for many years. From an annual trade show/symposium to a quarterly e-newsletter, the NSCC will keep its members informed about critical issues that can impact each center’s performance. Mission Statement The National Sports Center Consortium (NSCC) is an affiliation of Sports Centers that encourages business excellence by providing programs and services geared specifically to the sports center industry. Vision Statement The National Sports Center Consortium (NSCC) will be recognized as the leading National Organization for Sports Centers, committed to achieving business excellence and dedicated to the growth of centers in the sports, fitness, recreation and entertainment industry. Core Values The core values of the the National Sports Center Consortium (NSCC): • A commitment to meet the needs of our members • A commitment to business excellence • A commitment to fiscal responsibility • A commitment to family values • A commitment to the customer experience
title: THE OFFICIAL NATIONAL SPORTS CENTER CONSORTIUM
